messages:
elaine (CEO): Heads-up — brief all-hands this Thursday 10:00 AM PT in the main Zoom. Goal: announce a small data-retention policy change, Dedicated v1.2 launch callouts, and a short incident learnings recap. Please add Qs below. Agenda (15m total):
• 2m exec updates
• 4m product launch highlights
• 4m infra & incident summary
• 3m people & hiring
• 2m live Q&A
Recording will be posted after; if you need slides, add requests by EOD Wed.

sarah (Product): Added a slide for Dedicated v1.2. Need a one-liner on pricing transition for customers — @matt (IR) can you provide the wording?

matt (IR): Yes. Drafting a short blurb and a public FAQ page. Will paste link in this thread when ready.

devon (Eng): I'll take the incident summary. Plan to show the Feb outage root cause and the rollback we used. Thinking 1 slide + 90s animated timeline gif.

nina (People Ops): Hiring snippet: 8 roles opened last quarter, 3 offers extended. Can I have 30s to mention the referral bonus update?

ops-bot: Reminder: if you have questions, add them to this thread or use /ask-all-hands. Recording will be posted to #all-hands-recordings after the meeting.

elaine (CEO): Quick Q collection: what's the most important question your team needs answered? Keep them short. I'll start: "Will Dedicated customers on current contracts keep existing pricing?" and "Is there an ETA for an EU private control plane pilot?"

sarah (Product): From Product: rollout strategy for model version pinning; also, will Redwood Optimize cost suggestions be opt-in or auto-enabled for existing customers?

devon (Eng): Ops asks: please include p50/p95/p99 latency numbers for the demo environment. I'll prepare a slide with last week's numbers.

matt (IR): Draft FAQ link: https://redwood.in/faq-dedicated-pricing-draft — feedback welcome. Placeholder recording link: https://zoom.us/meeting/12345 (will be replaced with final recording).

elaine (CEO): Post-meeting action plan: we'll publish slides + transcript + 5 bullet takeaways in #all-hands-summary within 24h. Proposed takeaways: 1) Data-retention policy change (default 30d -> 90d opt-in for enterprise), 2) Dedicated v1.2 launch highlights and pricing transition timeline, 3) Incident follow-up: improved canary checks + automated rollback, 4) Hiring priorities + referral bonus update, 5) EU private control-plane pilot timeline. Assign owners and we'll track in the follow-up doc.

sarah (Product): For the policy blurb: legal confirmed compliance but we need an FAQ entry on how customers request longer retention — @nina can you coordinate the customer-facing wording?

nina (People Ops): On it. I'll draft HR-compatible and customer-facing wording and share by EOD.

devon (Eng): One more ask: can someone record the short demo clip for the rollback path? I have a conflicting call; if I can't, I'll upload before 2pm Wed.

elaine (CEO): Thanks — if you can't make the live session, still post Qs here and we'll cover them during the Q&A. Recording will be posted and I'll include the 5 takeaways + action owners.

matt (IR): Final quick ask: react with :thumbsup: to this thread when slides are uploaded so we know it's ready for review.

sarah (Product): Slides uploaded: https://drive.google.com/slide/d/1AbCdEfGhIjKl — pls review for content now.

devon (Eng): Reviewed, small nit on the incident timeline; added a comment on slide 6.

nina (People Ops): LGTM.

ops-bot: Meeting recorded. Recording: https://redwood.zoom/rec/abc987. Slides and transcript will be synced to #all-hands-summary automatically in ~10 minutes.

elaine (CEO): Postnotes: I'll post the short summary + action tracker in the channel and via email. Thanks everyone for moving fast."
